problems: extra: unknown key (expected one of: name, apps, entitlements, offerings, webhooks)
apps.ios.store: must be app_store or play_store
apps.android.package_name: required for play_store apps
apps.android.app_store_server_api: only app_store apps use the App Store Server API

apps.android.google_play_api.pubsub_push_account: must be a service account email, like rtdn-push@my-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
apps.android.google_play_api.pubsub_audience: must be a string
apps.android.allow_unverified_purchases: must be true or false
apps.android.sdk_keys[0]: must be 16–128 letters, digits or underscores

apps.android.products.pro.base_plans: must be a list of base plan IDs
apps.android.products.lifetime.subscription_group: only App Store subscriptions have a subscription group
apps.android.products.lifetime.type: must be one of subscription, non_consumable, consumable
apps.android.products.bad:id: invalid product ID
apps.android.products.bad:id: must be a mapping, e.g. { type: subscription }
apps.bad app: app IDs may only contain letters, digits, '.', '_', '-' and '$'

entitlements.empty.products: map each app to the products that grant this entitlement

offerings[0].packages[1].ios: unknown app ios
